plugins.name: DeepSeek
plugins.note: chat.deepseek.com with your own login; DeepThink and Search switches.

plugins.name: Qwen Chat
plugins.note: chat.qwen.ai with your own login (guests get "no permission"); Thinking and Search switches.

plugins.name: Chat screen
plugins.note: App part: the whole chat UI. Copy it to change anything you see.

plugins.name: Chat file
plugins.note: App part: the chat file format (ChatFile: Markdown with front matter). Replace it to save chats differently.

plugins.name: History
plugins.note: App part: chat files, folders, git and tags.

plugins.name: Local API jobs
plugins.note: App part: answers other apps' requests to the local API (/api/v1/chat, /v1/chat/completions) with runChat.

plugins.name: Markdown
plugins.note: App part: Markdown to HTML for replies and docs (mdToHtml). Replace it to change how Markdown looks.

plugins.name: Pipeline
plugins.note: App part: what goes to the site. Presets of pieces (your text), steps (plugins) and your message, in order, with groups and switches.

plugins.name: Sending
plugins.note: App part: the send pipeline, page pool, queue and PP.ask.
